scope: Additive TH18 regular Golem L1-L15 and required spawned Golemite L1-L15 baseline.
game_version: Supercell confirms Golem L15 availability on 2026-04-27; Goblins Farm reports the parent table from client build 18.600.3, while the Golemite table has no published client-build identifier.

sources.title: The Sound of Clash Update
sources.limitations: Confirms the permanent TH18 Golem level 15 release but publishes no parent or child combat table, split geometry or timing.

sources.title: Golem — Clash of Clans
sources.limitations: Reports current parent L1-L15 HP/DPS, 30 housing, ground targeting, 2.4-second cadence, one-tile range, speed 12, Defense preference and splitting qualitatively. It does not publish death explosion, child table, split count, individual spawn positions, collision or fixed-tick timing.

sources.title: Golem/Golemite
sources.limitations: Reports Golemite L1-L15 values, two/three/four split counts, Defense priority, ground targeting, 6 housing, speed 12, three-second cadence, 0.5 range and 1.2 death radius. It has no current client-build identifier; its prose says one fifth of parent stats while its L15 table is not one fifth of the current parent table.

support.note: The documented direct parent uses the shared Core Defense-priority route and sourced death split; Headless, Viewer and RL consume that state without separate combat rules.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only direct parent despite an existing generic Core death queue and frozen, secondary-provenanced L1-L15 table.
changed_values.replacement: The existing shared Core parent route, death explosion and deterministic Golemite queue are exercised through a focused Core/snapshot/replay test and public Headless CLI fixture.
changed_values.justification: Current build-pinned parent evidence and official TH18 L15 availability support the direct-parent baseline; no unsourced timing or geometry is added.

changed_values.previous_state: Spawned-only catalogue row with historical regression coverage but no focused snapshot/replay/adapter contract.
changed_values.replacement: The existing spawned-only child remains explicitly non-deployable and is covered through its parent’s sourced L1-L15 secondary table, level-15 four-child split, deterministic spawn queue and adapter-visible state.
changed_values.justification: The current secondary child page provides the table and parent-level count progression, but no build identifier or exact split geometry.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source defines the Golem death-explosion delay, explosion eligibility/order, split delay, individual Golemite spawn coordinates, overlap resolution, collision, first-target timing or same-tick ordering.

The current Golemite table is secondary and has no client-build identifier; its prose says a child has one fifth of parent DPS, death damage and HP, but its displayed L15 values 2,040/22/210 do not equal one fifth of the current L15 parent table.
No consulted source defines Golemite death-explosion timing/eligibility, parent-child retargeting, path topology, visual animation timing, or source-verified level-specific child assets.
conclusion: Golem L1-L15 and its required, explicitly non-deployable Golemite L1-L15 are executable through shared Core, Headless, Viewer and RL as a Defense-priority ground parent and deterministic child. The exact split/explosion geometry and timing, and current child-table fidelity, remain partial.
